gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Commanding up top, Bellota Text draws its outlines in one steady line. Alegreya Sans SC follows with a welcoming gap in the c, so a long stretch of sans text feels open and easy to move through.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-andika: Distinctive and a bit playful, Bellota Text leads. Andika follows in plain sans, its tails and terminals as thick as the stems, so a long page of it reads smoothly, with wide, easy turns in every s.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-finlandica: Contemporary and clean, Finlandica carries the text with crossbars that open their mouths, a line you could trace with a finger. Bellota Text earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-fustat: Fustat reads like bent rope or tubing, with a wide gap where each c ends. And Bellota Text above it keeps its outlines open, so a long passage moves along without any fuss.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gayathri: Gayathri reads approachable, its curves open-ended and its thick-thin variation mild like a letterpress slug. Gayathri sits beside Bellota Text, whose crossbars match its stems, and the two feel like a sturdy, friendly handshake.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads approachable and tidy, each curve finishing in a clean, open gap. And Bellota Text, drawn like a single thread, makes a long passage feel easy to follow.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-tha: IBM Plex Sans Thai reads modern, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers. Bellota Text above it has no hairlines at all, so a long passage moves along in plain sans without strain.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-inria-sans: Bent copper pipe, essentially. Inria Sans has tubular strokes and c openings you can see through, so a long stretch of sans-serif text under Bellota Text feels light and open.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-istok-web: Rounded and friendly, Istok Web has a clearly open side on its letters, set under a Bellota Text heading drawn in a single monoweight stroke. Long reading goes down easily.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-jost: Broad gaps, one unit-width stroke. Jost sits beneath Bellota Text like a plain sans, and a long passage in it reads clean and steady, with room around every terminal.
